notes.title: Devlog：Ver 0.3.0
notes.content:
[p]Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing Hounimal during Early Access!
In this devlog, I'd like to talk about the upcoming 0.3.0 update, scheduled for release in September.[/p][p][/p][p][i]※Please note that all screenshots are from content still under development.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Grid Enhancement[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/eadd190a53218ab35404cf507060feae66adc763.png"][/img][/p][p]As a unique Hounimal upgrade, you'll be able to get a "Special Grid" inside your Hounimal. [/p][p]We're considering this as an element that will affect both furniture placement and command battles, allowing commands from furniture placed on this grid to be used immediately at the start of combat.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Adventure Facility: The Saintess[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/acf9ecbcf01f7dc585bca1e140e6f690802ee7ee.png"][/img][/p][p]From Stage 5 onwards, you'll be able to meet the Saintess during your adventures. [/p][p]We're planning a facility where you can enhance your Hounimal using "Hounimal Seeds," which currently have no use outside of evolution.[/p][p]The rule is to choose one option for enhancement, but since it would be disappointing to visit and not be able to enhance anything, we're considering elements like "free options" and making "seeds easier to obtain during an adventure."[/p][p][/p][h2]New Hounimal[/h2][p][/p][p]We won't be revealing the silhouette this time, but we'll announce it on X before the update. [/p][p]The new Hounimal is designed for players who are already familiar with the Hounimal system, aiming for a fun experience that's easy to understand but technically challenging.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That's all for this update![/p][p][/p][p]The update is scheduled for late September. Please wait just a little longer! [/p][p]Thank you for all your reviews and feedback, even though the game is in Early Access. They really mean a lot. Also, please feel free to contact us with any requests or bugs you find.[/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Mini Update 0.2.1
notes.content:
[p]The following changes have been implemented:
[/p][p] Added[/p][list][*][p][b]In-game Guide[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You can now check Hounimal's basic rules from the pause screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/da1a3c562a499163134e9aa744cb26e158677bc5.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Command List Display on Furniture Reward Screen[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]You can now see what commands are available when choosing furniture rewards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/03ff097efef9639ce9f8fb6977bc0ebf837233a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Changed the description for "Triple Resonance Accel" and "Double Resonance Accel" to clarify they are permanent effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the description for the "House Breaker" debuff.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of Hounimal Furious Claws' companion spirit.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Bug Fixes [/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where controls would become unresponsive if a command reservation was canceled at a specific timing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some buff/debuff subtractions were not correctly applied only during boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where Hounimals sometimes couldn't be selected at the Monument after returning to base from an adventure.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where rewards and shop inventory would change after "Book of Lore."[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the protagonist's back hair would clip into furniture.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hounimal Ver0.2.0 Update Released!
notes.content: [p]Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your patience! The July 0.2.0 update, featuring a new Hounimal, has now been released! Check out the patch notes below![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Key Additions[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Hounimal "Furious Claws" & Facility "Monument with an Emblem"[/b] After clearing the second stage, you can select the Hounimal "Furious Claws" from the Monument. This Hounimal boasts a vertical layout and fights by transforming its rage into power.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Ceiling Furniture[/b] Easy to place in Hounimal's often-empty spaces, these furniture pieces don't add commands but offer powerful placement effects.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Command Reset Function[/b] Commands can now be reset after a CHAIN or after using Accel.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Stage "Tense"[/b] This is the fourth stage, featuring stronger enemies. It seems the Librarian will also lend a hand in your adventure. You might even meet the Saintess...[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]New Furniture Placement Effects[/b] Numerous effects have been added, including Command stat enhancements and buff acquisition upon drawing.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adventure Facility "Book of Lore"[/b] This facility alters adventure rules and difficulty in exchange for rewards like furniture and gold.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Base Facility "Forest Library"[/b] Here, you can view a list of your furniture. More information will be added in future updates.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Key Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Changed Command CHAIN Enhancement Description Rules[/b] Commands that previously activated additional effects at 2 or more CHAINS have been changed as follows: Old: "1 CHAIN or more" → New: "2 CHAINS or more" This change was made because the previous description was confusing; "X CHAINS or more" referred to the number of [i]activated[/i] commands, whereas "Xth CHAIN" referred to the Xth command [i]including unactivated ones[/i].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Other Additions & Changes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Added icons for Command Additional Effect Rules.[/p][list][*][p]Now you can see how many CHAINS are required for an additional effect on the command itself.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added New Command Enhancement Rules.[/p][list][*][p]Commands are enhanced when "consuming HP while command is usable" or "Weight Accel is unused."[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved Map Generation Logic.[/p][list][*][p]The same block will no longer spawn enemies and rewards simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Simple conversations added within each NPC facility.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 5 new disaster foes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 20 new furniture pieces (surpassing 100 total!).[/p][/*][*][p]Added 18 new commands (total for furniture, Hounimal, and enemies).[/p][/*][*][p]Added new NPC: The Saintess.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 new achievements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Adjustments[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Base facility menu, transitions, background.[/p][/*][*][p]Adventure facility background.[/p][/*][*][p]Base lighting, NPC positions, background.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause menu layout.[/p][/*][*][p]Buff and debuff icon sizes.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility for placed/unenhancable furniture in the list.[/p][/*][*][p]Hounimal grid colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Out-of-Place Artifact \[Shop] operation position.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Hounimal evolution effect misalignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Placement effect enhancements not updating with placement reset.[/p][/*][*][p]Description of "Ignition."[/p][/*][*][p]Map names in achievement descriptions.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Future Plans[/h3][p][/p][p]Before the planned September update, we intend to add the following highly requested features in the near future:[/p][list][*][p][b]In-game guide to review basic rules.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Command confirmation on the furniture selection screen.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]That's all for this update! It's been a while since the last Devlog, so we aim to post monthly updates going forward. If you have any bugs or requests, please don't hesitate to provide feedback![/p][p][/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Devlog：Ver 0.2.0
notes.content: [p]Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,[/p][p]Thank you for playing Hounimal during Early Access![/p][p]In this devlog, we'll talk about the 0.2.0 update, scheduled for release this month. [/p][p][i]※Please note that all screenshots are from content still under development.[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Command Reset Button & Command Boost Icons[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/5ffe18d7c5cb6f1c55a15d9d2b716597896efa4b.png"][/img][/p][p]We're adding a feature that lets you reset used Command Accels and reserved commands. We've also added icons to show information like the CHAIN count that boosts your commands.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Librarian Facility[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/d20466555480989d61cebfc0f76ab8cadf16a2e1.png"][/img][/p][p]From Stage 4 onwards, you'll be able to meet Librarians during your adventures. You can select a page from the Tome of Lore to receive rewards or alter the rules of your adventure.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Hounimals & Ceiling Furniture[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/fa5d5f73cd6a66cbde3a2833ab0081c55791772b.png"][/img][/p][p]New Hounimals with different room layouts and abilities will be added. ...It seems they have a vertically long silhouette. We're also planning to add "ceiling furniture" that can be placed in those often-empty high spaces.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]That's all for this update![/p][p][/p][p]We're aiming for a mid-July release, so please bear with us a little longer. And as always, please feel free to send us your feedback if you have any requests.[/p][p]See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Hounimal Development Roadmap Revealed
notes.content:
Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,

We are excited to share the development roadmap for the roguelite x housing RPG "Hounimal"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198353/aba69d0bb59f8969c56fbba162f370370abd3095.png[/img]

Thank you for all the gameplay and feedback since the start of Early Access. We are actively considering improvements based on the suggestions we’ve received.

As a general goal, we plan major updates approximately every two months, including the addition of new Hounimal.

With each update, more allies will gather at the base, and the story will progress toward the final battle against the source of the calamity.

Our target is to officially release the game within this year. We are also considering additional achievements as updates roll out, so if you've already purchased the game, be sure to check back and play again when new updates arrive!

If you notice anything while playing or have suggestions, feel free to share your thoughts with us.

See you soon!

notes.title: Mini Update 0.1.3
notes.content:
The following changes have been implemented:

Additions
・Unique VFX for Pressure and Absorption
・Base Facility: Hero’s Proof
　 Emphasized claim button for completed achievements
　 Added guide for claim operation

Bug Fixes
・Furniture could be illegally upgraded despite insufficient funds
・Accel obtained via command effects was not randomized
・Furniture could be placed on Classic Closet and Ghost Closet
・Combat could start before the map was generated
・Debuff “Furniture Breaker” was not activating properly
・Enemy command Quick Battle Icon was disappearing before activation

Adjustments
・Adjusted Reward UI (added text explaining selection rules)
・Adjusted command order for Red Vine enemies
・Improved display and evolution effects for Hounimal’s third evolution stage

notes.title: Mini Update 0.1.2
notes.content:
The following changes have been implemented:

Additions
・FPS settings (default is set to 60fps)
・Size and rarity indicators added to the furniture mouse-over UI
・Added annotation regarding Continue on the pause screen

Bug Fixes
・Defeating an enemy with a CHAIN attack was not counting toward achievements
・Command type icons were not being reflected in furniture enhancement information
・Merchant’s bag display issue fixed
・Display issue with Hounimal’s third evolution stage resolved

Adjustments
・Adjusted placement of certain furniture items
・Adjusted position of some enemy death effects

notes.title: "Hounimal" Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,

The roguelite x housing RPG "Hounimal" has officially launched in Early Access!

For one week starting today, we're running a 10% OFF launch sale. (Sorry we couldn't apply it right at launch!)

At this stage of Early Access, you can play three different stages.

We’ll also be sharing future update plans, so be sure to check them out!

See you soon!

notes.title: Bug Fix Update 0.1.1
notes.content:
The following issues have been fixed:
Resetting the layout caused the available space for placing furniture to shrink.
Maps beyond the current progress could be selected.
Canceling "Start from the Beginning" prevented it from being selected again.
Facility icons beyond the current progress were displayed.

notes.title: Early Access Launch Starts on April 25 (JST)!
notes.content:
Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,

We’re excited to announce that the roguelite x housing RPG "Hounimal" will begin its Early Access distribution on April 25!

At the Early Access stage, you’ll be able to play through three different stages.

After the launch, we plan to continue improving the game and adding more elements, such as new stages, furniture, and feature unlocks. We hope you enjoy playing at your own pace!

We’re also open to adjusting command balances as needed, so please don’t hesitate to share your feedback if there’s anything that catches your attention.

See you again soon!

notes.title: Hounimal Trailer Released
notes.content:
Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,

Today, we have released the trailer for our roguelite x housing RPG, Hounimal!

In the video, you can catch a glimpse of both the battles and the housing system. Make sure to check out the newly added enemies and furniture as well!

For the Early Access version, we plan to include some features, such as interactions with base NPCs and certain enhancements to the game cycle. Stay tuned and look forward to it!

We expect to announce the Early Access launch date very soon, so please hang in there just a bit longer!

See you again soon!

notes.title: Early Access Release of "Hounimal" Scheduled for 2025
notes.content:
Dear Prospective Residents of Hounimal,

We have news about the rogue-lite x housing RPG "Hounimal."

While we initially planned to release the store page for this work in September 2024, we have decided to adjust the schedule as follows to enhance and improve the final version.

-------------------------------
Scheduled for release in 2024
↓
Early Access beginning in Q1 2025
-------------------------------

We apologize for the change in release content and the short notice.

We are expanding the range of strategies compared to the initial content. Development is progressing smoothly, so please rest assured.

In Early Access, you will be able to experience the main game cycle. If you have any feedback after playing, please feel free to share it with us.

Lastly, we have updated the screenshots on the store page in line with this announcement! Please take a look if you're interested.
